description:
Role: FrontEnd UI Developer
Location: Riverwoods, IL
Duration: Fulltime

BGV will be done for the selected candidates.

Must Have :
Hands-on expertise on Web Technologies such as Html 5, CSS 3, jQuery, Spring MVVC and WebServices (SOAP/REST).
• Hands-on experience on an industry standard Responsive Web UI Frameworks such as React ,Angular JS or Ext JS.
• Strong command on JavaScript, Java/J2EE concepts and current UX industry trends.
• Deep understanding of both progressive enhancement and AJAX-based single page applications built using MVC based frameworks.
• Skilled in UX UI Design and UI Prototyping using tools such as iRise or similar.
• Strong understanding of Object Oriented design methodologies and design patterns.
• Understanding of the entire Software Development Life Cycle including requirements elicitation, design, development, test, release, and support and industry standards around the same.
• Knowledge of web-based enterprise level applications architecture.
• Experience with code build tools such as Maven, Ant or Git hub.
• Experience in being part of global delivery team with onsite/offshore model and coordination with support teams for deployment and issue handling.
